ms.promise:
To enable both open-source package AND simplified API service, the following outputs will be completed. 
1) Create the driver implementation for a Cardano node, published in github.
2) Create the collector implementation for decentralized exchange contracts, published in github. 
3) Update the REST API endpoints (which already pull from the centralized exchanges), to included decentralized exchanges, published in github.
ms.criteria:
Drivers and the collector are compatible with the latest Cardano node version.
REST API successfully integrates with the new drivers and collector.
All components pass testing with no critical bugs.
ms.report:
1) Create the driver implementation for a Cardano node, published in github.
Our driver utilizes the blockfrost Javascript SDK.
https://github.com/WolframBlockchainLabs/WolframPriceFeedInfrastructure/blob/main/lib/domain-collectors/integrations/udex/Cardano/BaseCardanoDriver.js#L4
We are currently using the latest blockfrost-js release 5.5.0
https://github.com/WolframBlockchainLabs/WolframPriceFeedInfrastructure/blob/main/package.json#L84
https://github.com/blockfrost/blockfrost-js
2) Create the collector implementation for decentralized exchange contracts, published in github.
The collector implementation handles: scheduling, communication and the methods to fetch and save the data. We created the exchange rate collector that pulls the data from the DEX and stores it in the database.
https://github.com/WolframBlockchainLabs/WolframPriceFeedInfrastructure/blob/main/lib/domain-collectors/collectors/ExchangeRateCollector.js
We also implemented the DEX contract drivers for Minswap, Muesli Swap, Sundae Swap, Vy Finance and Wing Riders
https://github.com/WolframBlockchainLabs/WolframPriceFeedInfrastructure/tree/main/configs/udex/cardano/exchanges
3) Update the REST API endpoints (which already pull from the centralized exchanges), to include decentralized exchanges, published in github.
We updated the REST API to include an endpoint to retrieve the exchange rate data, the documentation is available in our repo.
https://github.com/WolframBlockchainLabs/WolframPriceFeedInfrastructure/blob/main/docs/api/rest/exchange-rates.md
To validate the code quality we have implemented a test suite
https://github.com/WolframBlockchainLabs/WolframPriceFeedInfrastructure/tree/main/tests
The testing procedure can be found here:
https://github.com/WolframBlockchainLabs/WolframPriceFeedInfrastructure/blob/main/docs/quick-start.md#testing-procedures
We currently have 100% line coverage. All tests are passing and no critical bugs have been found.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Z5uGWI
